kind: four-stage process sequence (cross-sections, not to scale)
teaching_target: Freeze-thaw: water in an accessible joint, freezing with force against the walls, repeated cycles widen the joint, a fragment loosens; minerals unchanged.

stages.title: After many cycles of freezing and thawing

question_shows: water in the joint above 0 C
ice filling the joint below 0 C with force arrows on the walls
joint width 2 -> 2 -> 6 mm after many cycles
independent_solution: water enters joint and freezes to ice pushing on the walls (1)
repeated freeze-thaw cycles widen the joint 2 -> 6 mm (1)
loose fragment = physical breakdown with no mineral change (1)
assumptions: Widths illustrative, drawn to 8 px per mm; not a measured site.
No claim that one sub-zero reading breaks rock.
